title: Detecting Incorrect LLM Explanations for Automated Program Repair
title_zh: 检测面向自动程序修复的大语言模型错误解释

paragraphs.en: 提出蜕变测试方法MetaReJ，无需外部验证器即可检测自动程序修复中大语言模型的错误解释。 LLM-generated explanations help developers understand automated program repair (APR) rationale and assess patch quality. Incorrect explanations can mislead developers about a repair's reliability, making their detection important. However, manually inspecting the growing volume of generated repairs is impractical, motivating automated detection. Existing methods mainly target incorrect answers from general question-answering LLMs, often by sampling multiple responses and detecting contradictions. Applied to APR, they face two limitations: (1) they may depend on external verifiers that are unavailable or lack APR-specific reasoning; and (2) sampling strategies such as paraphrasing or re-prompting the same input often yield superficial, redundant responses that repeat the original error rather than expose it. We propose MetaReJ, the first method designed to detect incorrect APR explanations using metamorphic testing. Inspired by debate and viva examinations, MetaReJ challenges explanations through an argumentative strategy without requiring external verifiers. It applies novel metamorphic relations (MRs) to recursively question the LLM under equivalent and non-equivalent repair scenarios and detect contradictions. To obtain diverse samples, MetaReJ transforms the buggy program into variants that preserve or alter the underlying bug, then asks the LLM how to repair each variant. Contradictions among responses are encoded as MR violations, which indicate that the original explanation is incorrect. We evaluate MetaReJ on a manually labelled dataset of 1,756 explanations from multiple LLM-based APR systems. MetaReJ achieves an MCC of up to 0.43, outperforming prior methods by up to 333.3% in MCC.
paragraphs.zh: 提出蜕变测试方法MetaReJ，无需外部验证器即可检测自动程序修复中大语言模型的错误解释。大语言模型生成的解释有助于开发者理解自动程序修复（APR）的原理并评估补丁质量。 不正确的解释会使开发者对修复的可靠性产生误解，因此检测这些解释非常重要。 然而，人工检查数量不断增长的修复结果并不现实，这促使人们需要自动化检测方法。 现有方法主要针对通用问答大语言模型产生的不正确回答，通常通过采样多个回答并检测其中的矛盾来实现。 将这些方法应用于自动程序修复时存在两个局限：(1) 它们可能依赖不可用的外部验证器，或缺乏针对自动程序修复的推理能力；(2) 改述或对同一输入重新提示等采样策略往往只能产生表面化、冗余的回答，只是重复原有错误而非暴露错误。 我们提出MetaReJ，这是首个利用蜕变测试检测自动程序修复不正确解释的方法。 受辩论和口试考试的启发，MetaReJ通过一种论辩式策略对解释进行质疑，且不需要外部验证器。 该方法应用新颖的蜕变关系（MR），在等价和非等价修复场景下递归地询问大语言模型，并检测其中的矛盾。 为获得多样化的样本，MetaReJ将有缺陷的程序转换为保留或改变底层缺陷的变体，然后询问大语言模型如何修复每个变体。 回答之间的矛盾被编码为蜕变关系的违反，这表明原始解释是不正确的。 我们在一个人工标注的数据集上评估MetaReJ，该数据集包含来自多个基于大语言模型的自动程序修复系统的1,756条解释。 MetaReJ的MCC最高达到0.43，在MCC指标上比先前方法最高提升333.3%。
